mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product (seller_id, title, description, price, stock, category, image_urls, status, version) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{imageUrls}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE t_product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
